thread:
elaine (Partnerships): FYI DeltaWeights reached out — they want their quantized variants listed on AWS+Azure marketplaces and a co-branded SI bundle with EdgeSI. We need to nail payments, geo restrictions, and announce timing before we proceed.
mike_p (PM): Clarify the commercial flow: are they asking for Redwood-hosted access + marketplace resale, or to allow marketplaces to redistribute model artifacts?
sanjay (Legal): DeltaWeights signed our openweights template but added a commercial addendum. Highlights: revenue share needs negotiation, they insist on geo-blocking for certain APAC countries, and they prohibit sublicensing of raw weights to resellers without express consent.
tara (BizDev): Their starting ask: 70/30 rev-share on hosted usage. Marketplaces typically push for 85/15. SI (EdgeSI) also wants a 10% integration fee. These numbers clash.
elaine (Partnerships): Proposal: dual-path commercial model — Hosted on Redwood (70/30) and Marketplace listings via marketplace portals with a separate addendum (85/15). Add monthly proof-of-use reporting and a clawback if usage is misreported. Opinions?
sanjay (Legal): Dual-path is workable if we add provenance and attribution requirements. Must collect manifest metadata for each SKU: model_hash, training_data_origin, quantization_profile. Also need explicit invoicing flow: marketplace -> Redwood -> provider, 30-day settlement. And require an export-control warranty from the provider.
legal-bot: automated check: deltaweights_addendum.pdf contains "geo-blocking" clause? No. ACTION: request updated addendum with geo-block clause.
mike_p (PM): Implementation notes: catalog must distinguish SKUs as "hosted" vs "marketplace". Need entitlement flag to prevent Dedicated customers or private deployments from accidentally selecting marketplace-only variants. Ticket RD-OPS-8763 created for flag + routing; ETA ~2 weeks for basic UI + routing tests.
tara (BizDev): On the SI bundle — EdgeSI asks for a 60-day APAC exclusivity on joint announcements. Is that acceptable? Could block other partners in-region.
jess (Marketing): 60-day co-announce is okay if DeltaWeights pays for the co-marketing slot. We need joint PR draft 10 days prior and embargo alignment across marketplace listing date and Redwood console rollout. Also require logo and trademark sign-off.
elaine (Partnerships): Next steps: 1) Tara to negotiate marketplace split and SI fee; 2) Sanjay to request updated addendum with geo-block + settlement terms + export warranty; 3) Mike to implement SKU entitlement flag and routing; 4) Jess to prep co-marketing checklist and draft timeline.
tara (BizDev): I'll push marketplace split toward 80/20 baseline and push SI fee to 12% if possible. Will share negotiation notes with legal.
sanjay (Legal): Drafting an addendum request now. Will include clause: "No sublicensing of weights to third-party resellers without written consent from provider." Also adding export-control representation, and requirement for manifest metadata on each distributed SKU.
mike_p (PM): RD-OPS-8763: add catalog boolean "marketplace_available" + "marketplace_variant_id" and a routing policy to prefer hosted SKUs for Dedicated customers. Adding tests for entitlement propagation to Dedicated and Private stacks.
elaine (Partnerships): Thanks. I'll sync with DeltaWeights and EdgeSI, request their revised addendum and confirm marketing funding. Please update by EOD Wednesday. :thumbsup:
